en-US.name: OddsOff: Quit Gambling & Bets
en-US.subtitle: Betting Blocker & Recovery
en-US.promo: Block 2,900 betting apps and 278,000 gambling sites, ride out urges and watch the money you keep grow. Run the Reality Check: 1,000 versions of your next year.
en-US.description:
OddsOff helps you quit gambling for good: it blocks betting apps and sites, gets you through urges and shows you the money you keep, every single day.

A BLOCKER THAT ACTUALLY HOLDS
• Hides 2,900+ known betting, casino, poker and lottery apps with Apple's Screen Time
• Blocks major bookmakers and casinos in every browser, plus 278,000+ gambling sites in Safari (free)
• Add any app or site yourself: crypto apps, browsers, chat groups
• Commitment lock: switching it off needs a 24-hour, 3-day or 7-day cooldown, and OddsOff can't be deleted while locked
• Strong mode blocks new App Store installs

YOUR OWN SHIELD
Open a blocked app and you won't see a generic warning. You'll see your bet-free days, the money you've kept and the line you wrote to yourself on day one, with one tap to the urge timer.

REALITY CHECK
Run 1,000 versions of your next year with your own game, stake and frequency: accumulators, live bets, slots, roulette, blackjack, crash games, lottery. Watch the red lines sink while the green line, stopping today, keeps everything. Turn on "I chase losses" and see how fast it gets worse.

WHEN THE URGE HITS
• 5-minute urge-surfing timer and breathing exercises
• "Play the tape forward" to see where one bet really leads
• Private on-device coach that knows your triggers and never gives tips or odds
• Free, verified gambling helplines for your country and Gamblers Anonymous meetings
• Game Night Guard on your Lock Screen for big matches and payday nights

PROGRESS YOU CAN FEEL
• Live bet-free streak, money kept and milestones
• Evening check-in: mood, urge and triggers
• Patterns: your top triggers and riskiest hours, with a nudge before them
• Payday shield reminders
• Debt payoff plan that points your old gambling budget at your debts
• Signed commitment, widgets, share cards, Face ID

ODDSOFF PRO
Monthly or yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in Settings. The Safari web shield, urge timer, Reality Check and helplines are free.

OddsOff is a self-help tool, not a treatment. If gambling is hurting you or your family, please call a helpline or talk to a doctor.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your data never leaves your iPhone.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://kaanciner-design.github.io/fotoki/oddsoff/privacy.html
